visual_language.direction: simple clean business deck, generous whitespace, low-saturation neutral palette with a single soft accent, flat simple shapes, airy typographic rhythm, uncluttered premium restraint

legacy_payload.best_for: 需要干净、克制、易读的通勤商务演示,刻意强调留白与信息清晰度
legacy_payload.visual_direction: simple clean business deck, generous whitespace, low-saturation neutral palette with a single soft accent, flat simple shapes, airy typographic rhythm, uncluttered premium restraint

canvas.background: white or very light warm gray, wide margins
canvas.composition: one idea per screen, large breathing space, simple vertical/two-column flow
canvas.density: low to medium; content-first, minimal filler

color_palette.primary: soft neutral gray #6B7280 and near-white, with a calm base tone
color_palette.accent: one muted accent (soft blue #3B82F6 or sage #94A3B8)
color_palette.rule: simple, calm, low contrast; avoid heavy blocks, gradients, multiple bright colors

typography.title: light-weight large sans-serif (Inter / 思源黑体), airy and modern

layout_patterns: full-bleed clean statement slide with one idea
legacy_payload.layout_usage_rule: Let whitespace carry the design; keep every slide to one central idea and minimal chrome.

visual_elements.allowed: flat shapes, thin lines, simple icons, generous margin, one accent, subtle depth
visual_elements.avoid: heavy gradients, dense decoration, too many accents, infographic clutter, stock photography

rendering_constraints: Feels calm and premium; whitespace is intentional, not empty.
One accent repeated for identity; keep typography hierarchy strong.
No watermark, no invented logo; simple and honest.
